Name: EQUIPMENT_LINEUP_PARAM
Description: Shop lineup: the parts sold in the Parts shop, with their price, unlock flag, category and acquisition condition.

Fields.Name: Part ID
Fields.Description: The part to add to the Parts menu.

Fields.Name: Purchase Cost
Fields.Description: Shop price of the part. 0: cannot be sold.

Fields.Name: Unlock Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that unlocks this part for sale in the shop.

Fields.Name: Part Category
Fields.Description: The category this part appears under in the Parts menu.

Fields.Name: Counts for All Parts Trophy
Fields.Description: ON: the part counts toward the "Obtain All Parts" trophy.

Fields.Name: Reward Condition
Fields.Description: The reward condition to unlock this part with. Used for log hunter and mission rewards.
